name: Neutrino API
summary: Email syntax/DNS validation and SMTP verification, phone number validation and HLR lookups, IP geolocation, IP probing (hosting, VPN, proxy, ASN), IP blocklists and DNSBL host reputation, and domain intelligence.

user_id.description: Your Neutrino API user ID (the fixed ID of your account). Sent in the User-ID header.

api_key.description: A Neutrino API key (generated in your Neutrino account). Sent in the API-Key header.

notes: Every API takes its parameters over GET or POST; this entry uses GET. Field names in responses are kebab-case by default (output-case can switch to camel or snake).
Each API has its own rate and concurrency limits, listed per endpoint; past the concurrency limit the error code is 06 TOO MANY CONNECTIONS.
SMS Verify, Phone Verify and Phone Playback send messages or calls and are not in this entry; nor are the browser, HTML render and imaging APIs.

endpoints.name: Validate an email address (syntax and DNS)
endpoints.summary: Syntax, domain and MX checks, freemail, disposable and role (is-personal) flags, mail provider and domain status, with optional typo fixing.

fix_typos.description: Try to fix common domain, TLD and freemail typos (default false).

notes: Does not contact the mailbox: valid means the syntax, domain and MX servers work, not that the user exists. Use neutrino-api.email.verify for that.
domain-status: ok, invalid, no-service (null MX), no-mail, mx-invalid, mx-bogon, resolv-error. Up to 500 requests per second.

endpoints.name: Verify an email mailbox over SMTP
endpoints.summary: Everything email validate returns plus an SMTP check: verified, SMTP status and response, catch-all and deferred flags.

fix_typos.description: Try to fix common typos first (default false).

notes: Slow and variable: 1 to 120 seconds, so a call can outlast call_vendor's fixed 60-second timeout; retry a timed-out call. Limited to 2 requests per second and 50 at once.

endpoints.name: Validate a phone number
endpoints.summary: Whether a number is valid, its type (mobile, fixed-line, premium-rate, toll-free, voip), international and local formats, country, location and prefix network.

number.description: The phone number, in E.164 or local format; local format needs country_code or ip.

country_code.description: ISO 2-letter country to read a local number in.

ip.description: A user's IP address; the number is read in that IP's country.

notes: Does not contact the network; for live carrier status use neutrino-api.phone.hlr. Up to 500 requests per second.

endpoints.name: Look up a mobile number's live network status (HLR)
endpoints.summary: HLR status, current, origin and ported networks, ported and roaming flags, MCC/MNC and number type for a mobile number.

number.description: The phone number, in E.164 or local format; local format needs country_code.

country_code.description: ISO 2-letter country to read a local number in.

notes: Queries the mobile network, taking 1 to 5 seconds; limited to 20 requests per second and 50 at once.

endpoints.name: Geolocate an IP address
endpoints.summary: Country, region, city, coordinates, time zone, currency and language for an IPv4 or IPv6 address, with bogon and v6 flags and optional reverse DNS.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address; CIDR notation is accepted.

reverse_lookup.description: Also do a reverse DNS (PTR) lookup; adds delay.

endpoints.name: Probe an IP's network and provider
endpoints.summary: Provider, provider type, hosting, ISP, VPN and proxy flags, VPN domain, ASN, AS CIDR, domains and age, plus location.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address; CIDR notation is accepted.

notes: Runs live probes: 1 to 60 seconds, at most 10 requests per second.

endpoints.name: Check an IP against threat blocklists
endpoints.summary: Whether an IP is listed, on which blocklists, first and last seen, hits, and proxy, Tor, VPN, malware, spyware, bot, spam-bot, exploit-bot and hijacked flags.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address, with or without a port, or CIDR; with a comma-separated list the first non-bogon address is checked.

vpn_lookup.description: Include public VPN provider addresses (default false).

endpoints.name: Check a host against DNS blocklists
endpoints.summary: Whether an IP, domain or URL is listed on DNSBL zones, with each list's name, rating, TXT record and return code.

host.description: An IP address, domain, FQDN or URL; a domain or URL is checked against URI DNSBLs.

list_rating.description: Only check lists with this rating or better (default 3).

zones.description: Only check these DNSBL zones, comma-separated.

notes: Slow: 5 to 20 seconds, at most 1 request per second and 25 at once.

endpoints.name: Look up a domain's registration and reputation
endpoints.summary: Validity, TLD, rank, registration and expiry dates, age, registrar, mail and website status and providers, and adult, malicious, government and blocklist flags.

host.description: A domain, hostname, FQDN, URL, HTML link or email address; IDNs may be unicode or punycode.

live.description: Run live checks on domains not seen before (default true); set false for consistently fast replies.

notes: 15 ms to 5 s depending on live; at most 10 requests per second.
